name: design-review
description: Expert design and UX review of rendered web apps, websites, app UI flows, infographics and design artifacts — the last pass before a human looks at AI-built UI. Deterministic accessibility, contrast, target-size, performance, motion and layout-integrity gates first (column alignment, shared rails, section gaps, text overlap, dead space, affordance, token overloading); then structural, state, craft, flow and design-system passes against real renders at multiple viewports; then severity-ranked findings with pasteable fixes, evidence, and an explicit statement of what was never checked. v1.2.0 hardens against the two silent coverage failures: a review covering a subset of surfaces, and a review writing the report after only some pipeline stages. Both previously produced a report formally indistinguishable from a finished one. The surface set and the stage set are now enumerations fixed at stage 0, held in a scripts/worklist.py ledger (init fixes the count, set marks cells done or n/a-with-reason, check exits non-zero while any cell is open) so 'the review is finished' is an exit code rather than a feeling; an unrecognised cell counts as open deliberately. run_review.py gains --worklist/--surface and marks only the gates and render cells a successful capture actually proves. The surface sweep is the one loop with no budget, because a budget on it is indistinguishable from an excuse; the whole-review exit now also requires no open ledger cell. The verdict line carries the surface fraction on complete reviews too, so its absence never marks a review finished, and the coverage denominator comes from the stage-0 worklist rather than from what got reviewed. Stopping short is declared with a resume point; sampling is legitimate when declared with its basis and stated blind spots, silent sampling is not. Also adds imitation material as a craft finding and two Tier 2 source rules for it (stacked-inset-bevel, letterpress-text-shadow) with an evals fixture that drives both, a rebuild escalation when fixing every listed finding still would not produce a passable surface, and a rule that a fix invisible in the recapture is unresolved however confident the edit felt.
